title: UNI begins anniversary year with first day of classes
summary_en: UNI began a historic academic year as students returned to classrooms, just weeks before UNI marks 150 years since its first classes were held.
title_cn: UNI begins anniversary year with first day of classes

title: First-year teacher Miah Phalen prepares to welcome students
summary_en: For Miah Phalen, this back-to-school season is special. For the first time in many years, she’s not starting a new academic year as a student. This year, she’s the teacher, leading her own classroom at Weber Elementary School in Iowa City.
title_cn: First-year teacher Miah Phalen prepares to welcome students
